model.fidelity: RSS-inspired Kinova-7D adaptation; not the paper FR3 model
model.world_frame: right-handed world; coordinates and distances in metres
model.filter_policy: Unmodified CSD finalize_scene: exclude world-world, same link, adjacent links and fixed-connected links. Exactly equal to native Drake candidates for this model.
model.fixed_base_vs_online_voxels: CSD treats world-welded base as world, excludes it from online sphere tests; generator separately audits obstacle overlap with fixed geometry.
model.independent_checker: Drake signed primitive distances and Drake forward poses; analytic double precision sphere-to-box signed distance for online voxels
model.boundary_policy: Distances within 2 micrometres of contact are numerically ambiguous; keep raw CUDA and independent results, require both free and clearance above band for validation.
model.offline_online_identity: Every builder and runner constructs this same Model; legacy simple-model roadmaps must not be loaded.

upstream_model_difference.remedy: Build all new roadmaps from Model.csd_plant; never load upstream reduced-model roadmaps.
upstream_model_difference.conclusion: The reduced file collapses fixed chains. Both supplied models agree in primitive dimensions, limits and collision pairs, and in sampled poses to float32 precision. Different source files alone are not evidence of a physical-model mismatch; the new suite nevertheless freezes a single full-model construction for offline and online use.

workspace.note: Workspace samples audit the obstacle ROI; they do not prove reachability of every point.
